outputPath.description: Workspace-relative folder holding the BuildPlugin packages under package, their archives under archive, and automation reports under report

descriptor.description: Project .uproject or .uplugin, relative to the workspace root

hosts.description: .uproject files loading a plug-in, whose engine associations name each engine it builds, tests, and packs on

dependencies.description: Workspace plug-ins a .uplugin names, passed to BuildPlugin as -Dependencies

users.description: .uproject files enabling a plug-in that sits outside their plug-in folders, each receiving the package on install

operation.description: What runs: the build, the build under UnrealBuildTool static analysis, the automation tests named after the plug-in, the archives, or the copy into each user project

args.description: Arguments appended to the UnrealBuildTool, AutomationTool, or UnrealEditor-Cmd command

title: Unreal
description: Builds a .uproject's editor target through UnrealBuildTool, with its Clang static analyzer, unity builds off, and no precompiled headers for a check, or for a .uplugin packages it through AutomationTool's BuildPlugin with strict includes once per engine its hosts name, runs the automation tests named after it through UnrealEditor-Cmd in each host and reads their result from the exported report, zips each package and the tracked sources with the engine's EngineVersion after the store checks pass, or copies the package into the Plugins folder of each user project
